note: Held tier-5 English Wikipedia compilation for the KTO Rosomak. The registry marks primary_held false because the article is a secondary compilation. It publishes the weight, the overall length, width and height, the engine family, the engine rating of 405 kW (543 hp) with the DC 13 option as a separate row, the 8x8 arrangement, the maximum road speed and the road range. It publishes no ground clearance, no tyre size, no transmission, no torque and no grouser statement, so the entry is not runtime-ready.
